name: QxGH
description: QxGH — watch GitHub Actions and Releases from public github.com pages (no REST API). Business-only workbench UI.

descriptions.en: Monitor Actions runs and Releases for public GitHub repositories, with build status, estimated progress, and Island updates.
descriptions.zh-CN: 监控公开 GitHub 仓库的 Actions 运行与 Releases，并显示构建状态、预计进度和灵动岛提醒。

author: mcx

preferences.label: Repositories
preferences.description: Public owner/repo — one per line. Reads github.com HTML (no API token).

descriptions.en: Public owner/repo — one per line. Reads github.com HTML (no API token).
descriptions.zh-CN: 公开 owner/repo，每行一个；读取 github.com 网页，不需要 API 令牌。

preferences.label: Poll interval (seconds)
preferences.description: Auto-refresh while the panel is open. 0 disables polling.

descriptions.en: Auto-refresh while the panel is open. 0 disables polling.
descriptions.zh-CN: 面板打开时自动刷新；0 表示关闭轮询。

preferences.label: Cache minutes
preferences.description: SWR: treat cached Actions/Releases as fresh for this many minutes.

descriptions.en: SWR: treat cached Actions/Releases as fresh for this many minutes.
descriptions.zh-CN: 将缓存的 Actions/Release 视为新鲜数据的分钟数。

preferences.label: Island for in-progress runs
preferences.description: Show external QxIsland when a watched repo has a running/queued workflow.

labels.zh-CN: 在灵动岛显示运行中的任务

descriptions.en: Show external QxIsland when a watched repo has a running/queued workflow.
descriptions.zh-CN: 监控的仓库有运行中或排队中的工作流时显示 Qx 灵动岛。

preferences.label: Show active deployment in tray
preferences.description: Add an OS-native QxGH tray submenu with deployment percentage, elapsed time, and refresh actions.

descriptions.en: Add an OS-native QxGH tray submenu with deployment percentage, elapsed time, and refresh actions.
descriptions.zh-CN: 添加带部署百分比、耗时和刷新操作的 QxGH 托盘子菜单。

commands.name: refresh-qxgh
commands.title: Refresh QxGH
commands.description: Force refresh Actions and Releases for pinned repos

descriptions.en: Force refresh Actions and Releases for pinned repos
descriptions.zh-CN: 强制刷新固定仓库的 Actions 和 Releases。

commands.name: qxgh-status
commands.title: QxGH CI Summary
commands.description: Toast a short summary of latest runs

descriptions.en: Toast a short summary of latest runs
descriptions.zh-CN: 提示最新运行任务的简要摘要。

commands.name: qxgh-watch-island
commands.title: QxGH Watch on Island
commands.description: Pin the hottest in-progress run on the external island

descriptions.en: Pin the hottest in-progress run on the external island
descriptions.zh-CN: 将最活跃的运行中任务固定到外部灵动岛。
